claim: IRENA's Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2024 report gives the global weighted-average LCOE of newly commissioned utility-scale solar PV as $43/MWh in 2024 (2024 USD), down from $417 (2010), $135 (2015), $79 (2018), $61 (2020) and $51/MWh (2022).

note: IRENA's datafile for the report (sheet 'Fig S.1', 2024 USD/kWh) gives the annual series; its Solar photovoltaic row has 2010 0.41696, 2015 0.13511, 2018 0.07864, 2020 0.06100, 2022 0.05109, 2024 0.04262. The report's summary table states the 2010 and 2024 values. Corrected from pilot-2025: 2015: 127 -> 135, 2018: 85 -> 79, 2020: 55 -> 61. Observations: ledger/reverify/fusion.2026-10-16-obs.jsonl.
